name: CanvasHeader
intent: The canvas-level header bar: a left cluster (typically a breadcrumb, single-line + truncating), an optional center, and a right cluster with an optional built-in weekSelector plus your actions. Heads a single workspace canvas — distinct from the platform CoreAppTopBar.
when: Heading a single workspace canvas with a breadcrumb + period selector
Pairing a view switcher / canvas toolbar with a titled header

chooseOver.because: CanvasHeader heads one workspace canvas; CoreAppTopBar is the platform-level application top bar

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation

props.name: left
props.description: Left cluster — typically a `Breadcrumb`. Takes the free width and stays on a single line.

props.name: center
props.description: Optional centered cluster (e.g. a title or a segmented control).

props.name: right
props.description: Right cluster actions (e.g. a full-screen `Button`), placed after the built-in `weekSelector`.

props.name: weekSelector
props.description: A built-in period selector at the start of the right cluster. Pass the WeekSelector's props; it renders `bare` so it sits flush in the bar. The canvas header and a period selector are paired frequently, so this composes them for you (override the layout with the `right` slot instead).

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.
